title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0938, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.0938, 0.0) to (0.0938, 0.75), followed by the third line from (0.0938, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75), and finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.75) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0141 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The resulting rectangular bar has a length of 0.09375000000000001 units, a width of 0.7500000000000001 units, and a height of 0.014062500000000004 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0938, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0938, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0141)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
